name: Bug report
description: Report a reproducible problem
title: "[Bug] "
labels: ["bug"]
body:
  - type: textarea
    attributes:
      label: What happened?
      description: Describe the bug and what you expected.
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    attributes:
      label: Steps to reproduce
      description: List steps, sample data, or screenshots if helpful.
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    attributes:
      label: Environment
      description: OS, Python/Node versions, browser (if frontend), and how you installed.
